integrity: The proof is a statement-level consequence of the motivating paper's verified lower and upper estimates together with exact diagonal identities for its joint oscillation quantities and the classical John--Nirenberg equivalence of finite BMO moments. The lower and upper implications, local-integrability requirements, and partial-transpose placements were checked in the full primary text. No numerical experiment is used.
scientific_limitations: The result only removes the oscillation-exponent gap on the diagonal tuple b1=b2 and does not solve the distinct-symbol endpoint problem. No sharp numerical comparison constants are claimed. Necessity uses the motivating paper's geometric non-degeneracy hypothesis.
title: Diagonal collapse of the oscillation-exponent gap for bilinear rough commutators
